raw_segments.text: King Henry, my lord of Warwick and my brother Gloucester, follow Flulan closely at the heels.
The glove which I have given him for a favor may happily purchase him a boxo, the ear.
I by bargain should wear it myself.
If that the soldier strike him, as I judge by his blunt bearing he will keep his word,
some sudden mischief may arise of it, for I do know Flulan valiant and touched with collar,
hot as gunpowder, and quickly will return an injury.
Follow and see there be no harm between them.
Go you with me, Uncle of Exeter.
